items.title: It was a next-man-up mentality for the Lakers with Austin Reaves and Quentin Grimes out, and Sandro Mamukelashvili answered the call. He had his best game in a purple and gold uniform and was a big reason why the Lakers are the first team in the NBA to reach double-digit wins.

items.title: The Lakers finish strong down the stretch, beating the Hawks 124-114 on the road. Luka Dončić scored 32 points. Walker Kessler had another double-double with 21 points and 10 rebounds. Off the bench, Sandro Mamukelashvili had 23 points, and Collin Sexton scored 18 in the win.
items.author: Edwin Garcia
items.body_excerpt: The Lakers finish strong down the stretch, beating the Hawks 124-114 on the road. Luka Dončić scored 32 points. Walker Kessler had another double-double with 21 points and 10 rebounds. Off the bench, Sandro Mamukelashvili had 23 points, and Collin Sexton scored 18 in the win.

items.title: Sandro Mamukelashvili off the bench vs the Hawks: 23 PTS 8 REBS 3 ASTS (0 TO) 1 STL 1 BLK on 7-13 FG 5-8 3PT 4-4 FT
items.author: KarrotMovies
items.body_excerpt: He's such a monster offensively. So happy with how he's played for us. Easily his best game in purple and gold. Hoping for even more from you Mamu. Lakers advance to 10-2!!! Holding the best record in the league. Maybe this Lakers team is good. Idk. Box Score
